name: Raguel
description: Of Ecbatane in Media, called Tobit's cousin; father of Sara and husband of Edna; gave Sara to Tobias in marriage according to the law of Moses

points: The angel told Tobias that Raguel his cousin had one only daughter, and the right of her appertained to him, seeing he only was of her kindred.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Raguel could not marry her to another according to the law of Moses but would be guilty of death; giving land away to whom it does not belong carried death.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: For before the days of the marriage were finished, Raguel had said unto him by an oath, that he should not depart till the fourteen days of the marriage were expired.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Raguel had given Tobias half his goods at the wedding, after a fourteen-day feast, with the rest promised when he and his wife were dead; the father-in-law's inheritance passed to the son-in-law.

Tobit died at a hundred and fifty-eight, and after Anna died Tobias went to Ecbatane to Raguel his father-in-law, buried him and his mother-in-law honorably and inherited their substance, and his father Tobit's as well.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
